entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-53p3-c7vp-4mcc: Trix is vulnerable to XSS through JSON deserialization bypass in drag-and-drop (Level0InputController)
entry.content:
Trix is vulnerable to XSS through JSON deserialization bypass in drag-and-drop (Level0InputController)

Aliases: CVE-2026-73427

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:A/VC:N/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • trix — fixed in 2.1.18
  • action_text-trix — fixed in 2.1.18

### Impact The Trix editor, in versions prior to 2.1.18, is vulnerable to XSS when a crafted `application/x-trix-document` JSON payload is dropped into the editor in environments using the fallback Level0InputController (e.g., embedded WebViews lacking Input Events Level 2 support). The `StringPiece.fromJSON` method trusted `href` attributes from the JSON payload without sanitization. An attacker could craft a draggable element containing a `javascript:` URI in the href attribute that, when dropped into a vulnerable editor, would bypass DOMPurify sanitization and inject executable JavaScript into the DOM. Exploitation requires a specific environment (Level0InputController fallback) and social engineering (victim must drag and drop attacker-controlled content into the editor). Applicatio…
